name: solar-ui
description: SolarUI design tokens — layers mirroring the Figma variable collections: Mode (Radix Colors), Screen (responsive sizes and type scales) and Theme (semantic tokens, one file per theme: Stellar and Trevia).
docs: Add `@import "./theme.css";` to your globals.css, right after `@import "tailwindcss";`. It pulls in `radix.css`, `screen.css` and the theme files itself. The theme imported last in `theme.css` provides the defaults — swap the two `@import "./themes/*.css"` lines to change it. Any theme stays reachable at runtime with `data-theme="stellar"` or `data-theme="trevia"` on `<html>`; dark mode uses the `dark` class. Theme defaults are declared with `:where(:root)`, so your own `:root { --color-brand-9: … }` overrides them without `!important`.
